prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look.
"Hafenkante", a wide rusty harbour quay in the underground slums, seen from above. A huge flat band of cracked dark concrete quay with yellow painted edge lines, rail tracks sunk into the ground and wet puddles mirroring neon runs across the whole upper half of the image from the left edge to the right edge - this is the large walkable area. In the lower right a greenish, faintly glowing harbour basin of murky water fills the bottom right quarter, with an oily rainbow sheen.
TOP LEFT: a corrugated-metal garage with a wide open roll-up door, inside a half-dismantled old station wagon on jack stands with its hood open, tools on a wall, a worn punching bag hanging from a chain beside the car.
TOP, between garage and the rest: a narrow steel stair and footbridge (gleissteg) rising up and out of the top edge of the image toward a train station, with a cyan railing; right of it a stairwell going down into a metro station with a glowing cyan railing and a round metro emblem (no letters); a tiny signal box hut with blinking lamps next to the steel stair.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT: a long corrugated sheet-metal race hall with a big closed rolling gate and a huge chequered finish flag hanging over the gate - the most eye-catching spot, lit by orange and pink neon stripes; a small snack kiosk booth with a striped awning beside it.
TOP RIGHT CORNER: a clean white corporate delivery depot behind a tall chain-link fence with a gate, white shipping containers, a loading dock and a cold white floodlight mast - sterile and out of place.
RIGHT EDGE middle: a massive round rusty overflow pipe outlet with a heavy grate set into a concrete wall, dripping.
LOWER LEFT: a labyrinth of stacked shipping containers (red, blue, rust-orange, yellow) with narrow walkable lanes between them, covered in colourful graffiti shapes (no letters); one red container has a big painted shark on its side and roof; one yellow container stands slightly apart with a padlocked door.
CENTER, at the water edge: a small fish stall with a blue tarp awning, crates of ice and nets.
ALONG THE QUAY EDGE on the right: two giant rusty container gantry cranes standing on four legs each, their booms reaching out over the water, warning lights on top; at the far right end of the quay towers of stacked oil barrels.
IN THE WATER: a narrow wooden pier leading out to a cosy patched-up houseboat with a cabin, round portholes with warm yellow light, potted plants and a big brass foghorn on the roof; a short fishing jetty; on the right a small old ferry boat with orange life rings docked at its own short pier.
Small stuff at the edges: bollards with ropes, coiled chains, pallets, a drain grate in the ground, cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor. 
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: LEFT edge (west) - the quay continues as a road between scrap fences toward a scrap market; TOP edge (north) - the steel footbridge stair leaves the image toward the train station; BOTTOM LEFT edge (south) - a concrete ramp slopes down out of the image toward a flood wall.
Time: night, after rain.
